summary: Renaming a group now renames it in Entra ID, and access reviews get the permission they need.

fixes.title: Group renames reach Entra ID
fixes.text: A rename still created a second group in the previous version. The engine now renames the group it already has.

fixes.title: Access reviews get the right permission
fixes.text: The deployment now grants the access review permission Microsoft requires, which also covers reading and changing other reviews. Reviews are then created and mail their reviewers.
fixes.action: Grant the hosting permissions again so the new access review permission takes effect.

fixes.title: Reset TAP explains when it cannot work
fixes.text: Without a mail sender, Reset TAP in Accounts & TAP is now disabled and says why: a pass is only ever sent by mail.
